message.reasoning:
I need to make a Monopoly decision.

I have $382 and am on COMMUNITY_CHEST. I own three mortgaged properties: BALTIC, VERMONT, and CONNECTICUT. Oriental is owned by another player, so I do not yet control the light blue monopoly.

I control the pink and orange monopolies with two and four houses respectively. Player two holds the red monopoly and Boardwalk unmortgaged, plus mortgaged Pacific and Pennsylvania. Player four owns the yellow monopoly and several mortgaged railroads and utilities.

Player three is bankrupt. Player two has $345 and player four has $126. The bank holds zero houses but twelve hotels. North Carolina is unowned. I will keep the housing lock: no hotels, no house sales, and no junk unmortgaging. The orange properties already have four houses each, so building hotels would cost an extra $100 per property.

Building hotels on the orange properties would return four houses to the bank. Player two could then purchase two of them to complete his red monopoly at four houses each, raising his rent to over $1100. The extra rent from hotels is not worth giving player two that opportunity.

Player two's red properties rent $700 each at three houses and $925 at four. The $382 cash buffer is enough to cover those red rents without unmortgaging the light blue properties.

Player four's yellow properties rent $110 each at one house and $360 at two. I just paid $110 on Atlantic, leaving me with $382. I am considering a trade.

Trading houses is not allowed while buildings are present. I could offer my mortgaged properties or a Get Out of Jail Free card. Player four owns Oriental and Mediterranean, but acquiring them would require cash to unmortgage and the light blue rent increase is too small to justify the cost. Player two likely wants Park Place from player four, who holds it mortgaged.

Player four has roughly $126 in cash plus liquidated houses and mortgages. The orange properties rent $750 each at four houses, so landing there would bankrupt them or cripple them. I will not give player two cash.

I will end my turn. I considered trading for Park Place or Oriental, but player four would not give them away cheaply, and I lack the cash to develop a dark blue or light blue monopoly while houses remain locked.

I am weighing whether to sell my Get Out of Jail Free card for cash. A previous offer of fifty dollars was rejected. The card is useful if I land on a jail space, but it does not generate income on its own.

Player four is too desperate to pay for a Get Out of Jail Free card. Player two would not trade away his red monopoly for my properties. North Carolina is unowned and no one can complete the green monopoly. I will end my turn.
